newsitem.title: UK: EBRD president de Larosiere to leave end Jan 1998.
newsitem.headline: EBRD president de Larosiere to leave end Jan 1998.

text.p: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development said in a statement on Friday its president Jacques de Larosiere will leave his office at the end of January 1998.
The EBRD said the move was for personal reasons.
De Larosiere, who had been asked to serve another term as president when his present term ends on September 27, will extend his current contract until January 30, 1998 to ensure a smooth transition.
That extension will be put to the EBRD's board of governors for its approval.
The board will elect a new president in due course, the statement said.
